description: This file contains unit tests for the LanguageDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin Plugin. It tests various CRUD operations and lookup functions related to Language entities, including adding, editing, retrieving by ID or name, listing, and deleting languages.

classes.name: LanguageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LanguageDao data access object, covering operations like create, read, update, delete, and validation for language entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by instantiating LanguageDao and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testAddLanguage
methods.description: Tests adding a new language and verifies it was saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditLanguage
methods.description: Tests editing an existing language and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a language by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of languages with filtering parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple language entries.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deleting a non-existent language record.

methods.name: testIsExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Verifies the existence check for language names, ignoring case and whitespace.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a language by name, case and whitespace insensitive.
